[EN] It took a hundred castanic engineers three weeks to blast our way through to {@Rgn:49001}.

Naturally, as soon as we saw blue light, the others took off for drinks.
[ES] A cien ingenieros castanic les tomó tres semanas abrirnos paso a golpes hasta {@Rgn:49001}.

Naturalmente, tan pronto como vimos la luz azul, los demás se fueron a tomar algo.
